anti_leakage_and_interpretation.application_status: co-movement diagnostic only; no hedge effectiveness, investment, trading, or profitability claim
anti_leakage_and_interpretation.benchmark_panel_status: ex-post survivor/news-visible cohort; feature-only screening does not repair point-in-time-universe or W_{t+1}-availability limitations
anti_leakage_and_interpretation.either_window_screen_status: retrospective data-quality sensitivity; not an implementable ex-ante screen and not a leakage-free live backtest

configuration.aggregation: six transitions receive equal weight in macro means; NDCG also reports query-weighted means; basket pooled variance reduction sums per-query target and error variances within transition, then macro-averages transition values
configuration.application_diagnostic: unfitted equal-notional arithmetic mean of five selected peer raw FF5 residual paths in W_{t+1}
configuration.base_universe: lexicographically sorted intersection of W_t and W_{t+1} return availability and non-empty W_t vintage 10-K Item 1

frozen_blend.selection: alpha selected only on historical transitions

metric.name: canonical positive-relevance NDCG@5
metric.query_policy: every security retained by each screen
metric.tie_handling: canonical seeded jitter with TIE_RNG_BASE plus sorted screened-universe query index

configuration.return_path: cosine similarity of W_t standardized raw FF5 residual paths

screens.exclude_rule: exclude security if max absolute daily raw FF5 residual exceeds 1 in W_t
exclude security if max absolute daily raw FF5 residual exceeds 1 in either W_t or W_{t+1}
exclude security if max absolute daily raw FF5 residual exceeds 0.5 in W_t
exclude security if max absolute daily raw FF5 residual exceeds 0.5 in either W_t or W_{t+1}

tfidf.refit_policy: vocabulary and IDF refit for each screened corpus
tfidf.selection: configuration b selected only on historical transitions

limitations: The primary either-window filter is outcome-aware because it uses W_{t+1} residual magnitudes; it is suitable only as a retrospective data-quality sensitivity.
A large residual is not proven to be erroneous.  The 1.0 and 0.5 cutoffs are transparent magnitude screens, not issuer-specific corporate-action adjudications.
The base universe inherits the paper's ex-post candidate cohort and conditions on target-window return availability.
Equal-notional basket variance reduction can be negative and is not evidence of a viable hedge; costs, constraints, and factor-leg implementation are absent.
Adjacent modern transitions are dependent.  Results are descriptive; no IID p-values are reported.
